dialogue.line: Pant... pant... pant...
(Why are there so many etherbeasts around here...?! There must have been a thousand of them!)
(I didn't expect the Garuda to be this dangerous at night...)
(Almost makes me miss the assassins hunting me.)
(Still... I suppose it's preferable to the Behemoth. I never want to return to that cursed land...)
Hah... marvelous, truly marvelous... I can only hope the small town that beastman mentioned isn't much further.
...It appears I have a more pressing matter to attend to, do I not?
You've been tailing me since I left the last town, haven't you?
I know you're there, stop trying to hi—!
A figure clad entirely in black leaps out in front of you, wielding two curved daggers, their face hidden beneath a hood.
They attack you.
The figure falls to their knees, clutching their stomach in pain.
A commendable effort, I must admit. Crossing a single sword against twin daggers is hardly the most elegant of encounters.
Nggh...!
Who are you? Do you work for *them*?
Ahh... Ahahah! Do you really think... I'd tell you that?
You're... a woman?
Oh dear... is your fragile ego hurt?
Hardly. Though I would point out that you are the one currently resting in the dirt, not I.
Ngrrh! How dare you...
I don't really care about your identity, but deliver this message to your employer: your reign of terror over the people of Thesmos is drawing to a close.
Have I made myself clear?
This... isn't over!
I am afraid it is. This time, I merely brought you to your knees. Should we cross blades again, I will ensure you do not rise.
I'll kill you...
The woman gets back to her feet, her piercing light blue eyes glaring into yours as she grits her teeth.
A blonde lock slips from beneath her hood, falling across her face.
I swear I'll kill you...
Do you have any idea how many times I have been promised the very same thing?
With a final, hate-filled glare, the woman darts away toward the woods.
(Will they ever get tired of sending these assassins after me?)
(Haah... Let's keep moving and hope that town is truly close.)

story.end: The city gates are open. End of the demo.
